description: This file contains functions for creating media snapshots and extracting media events/sequences based on coded behavioral observations in the BORIS software. It interacts with media files, database, and GUI dialogs to process and export video/audio segments.

methods.name: events_snapshots
methods.description: Creates snapshots from coded events, extracting frames from media files around event occurrences, with options for image format and directory selection.

methods.name: extract_events
methods.description: Extracts media sequences (video/audio) corresponding to coded events, with options for time offset, media track type, and output directory.
